title: British Massaman Fish Curry
description: A British take on the traditional Thai Massaman curry, featuring fish as the main ingredient.

ingredients.name: Fish Fillets
ingredients.notes: Any firm white fish works well (e.g. cod, haddock)

instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add the onion and cook until softened (5 minutes).
3. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add the Massaman curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add the fish stock and bring to a simmer.
6. Add the coconut milk and stir to combine.
7. Add the fish fillets and cook for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
8. Season with salt, black pepper, and chopped coriander.
9. Serve hot with warm rice or naan bread.
